question: The edge of a cube is 19 cm. What is the total surface area of the cube (in cm²)?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Surface Area of a cube = 6 × a²

Substitute the given edge a = 19 cm directly into the formula.

TSA = 6 × 19² = 6 × 361

TSA = 2166 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 2166 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Lateral Surface Area of a Cube

The lateral surface area includes only the 4 vertical side faces, excluding the top and bottom. LSA = 4a².

Volume of a Cube

The total 3D space occupied by the cube is given by Volume = a³.

Diagonals of a Cube

Face Diagonal = a√2 | Body Diagonal = a√3, which represents the longest rod that can be perfectly placed inside the cube.
